events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art began on this day in 1969, drawing hundreds of thousands to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years ago, the Woodstock Festival kicked off three days of peace, love, and iconic music. What's your favourite performance from the legendary event?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. His music and legend live on. What's your top Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders tune?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 49 years ago, John Lennon gave us the timeless anthem 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly today as ever.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple launched the first generation iPod on this day in 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: The Original Music Player
angles.copy: Remember this? 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which Bond film or song is your ultimate favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true icon of British comedy.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: 35 years since the world said goodbye to the legendary Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
